values.note: $30 a day, $125 a week (7 days), $300 a month; 3- to 6-month seasonal rates ($900-$1,800) with 20% off if paid by June 1. A $5 fee locks a particular site when booked through the city's online reservation software; cancellations more than 7 days out are refunded less $20. Rates are set by council each January.

values.note: Book by calling City Hall (218-843-2737). Payment is due before setting up: at the Police Department, City Hall, or the drop boxes in the park. Check-out 12 p.m.

values.note: Officially open from the beginning of May (weather permitting) until September 30, then open day to day after that; utilities go on and off with the weather.

note: City of Hallock campground in Gilbert Olson Park on the South Branch of the Two Rivers. Sites 15-20 line the riverbank. Swimming pool, playground, picnic shelter and ball diamond in the park; golf course nearby. Many sites go to monthly and seasonal campers. --Claude
summary: City camping page, 2024 rules/policies PDF and 2023 site map read via headless browser: $30 a day ($125 week, monthly/seasonal rates), book by phone with City Hall, open May 1 to Sep 30 (day to day after), 30/50A, showers, dump, WiFi. Creekside kept (sites 15-20, river ~22-26 m wide). Phone added.
flags: PHONE: none stored -> 218-843-2737 (City Hall, 'Call City Hall to book your reservation').

WATERFRONT creekside kept: on the city's 2023 map sites 15-20 sit in a row on the north bank of the South Branch Two Rivers (row ~48.7690,-96.9349), pads ~10-15 m from the water over grass with a thin brush edge; E1 and E3-E5 sit near the river's east bend among trees. The channel at the sites is ~22-26 m wide on Esri imagery, so creekside, not riverfront.

SITES: the 2023 map labels sites 1-20, D1-D7 and E1, E3-E5, E12-E19 (39 labels; E2 and E6-E11 not shown). The stored count 48 (derived from old note prose) is not confirmed by any city page; left unchanged.

LONG-STAY (local, five tests): the city posts a $30 nightly rate and takes phone reservations (tests 1-2 pass), but the rules are written around monthly/seasonal campers ('All seasonal spots must have the deposit to reserve the following summer ... the spot will be offered to the first person on the waiting list'; seasonal campers must trim under their campers). The share of sites sold by the night is not stated anywhere. The operator's own wording does not discourage nightly guests ('ideal for everything from weekend getaways to extended stays'). Read as a city park with a large seasonal share, not mostly seasonal on the evidence; reviewer may want a nightly-share call (218-843-2737). Earlier verifier noted Google 4.4/16.
